title: Magnesium and Migraine.
relevance_note: A 2025 review of magnesium in migraine. It is background for the working idea of a migraine-spectrum problem and for the question of morning magnesium threonate. It is not an instruction to start or stop a supplement.

title: Review of Tolerability of Fremanezumab for Episodic and Chronic Migraine.
relevance_note: A review of fremanezumab, the medicine in Ajovy, for prevention of episodic and chronic migraine. Whether to start it is a question for a clinician. This note does not include a dose.

title: Histamine plasma levels from dietary histidine/histamine intake correlate with CGRP in trigeminal tissues.
journal: The Journal of Headache and Pain
relevance_note: A laboratory study in mice, not a human trial. It reports that dietary histidine and histamine were associated with CGRP in trigeminal tissue. That is background for the histamine trigger idea and for trying a low-histamine pattern again. It is not a meal plan.

title: Evidence for Dietary Management of Histamine Intolerance.
relevance_note: A review of histamine intolerance and the low-histamine diet used to assess it. It is background for the histamine trigger idea and for the yogurt and low-histamine question. It is not a personalized diet.

title: Navigating Complexity in Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome.
relevance_note: A review of POTS physiology, including fluid intake, dehydration, small-fiber neuropathy, and mast cell activation. It is background for those working ideas and for steadier hydration. It is not a fluid target.

title: Exercise Interventions in the Management of Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome: A Scoping Review.
relevance_note: A scoping review of exercise programs studied in POTS, including aerobic work and later walking. It is background for more outdoor time and gentle movement. It is not a training plan.
intervention_names: More outdoor time, walking, and gentle movement

title: Idiopathic hypersomnia is a 24-hour disorder.
relevance_note: A review of idiopathic hypersomnia across the day and night, including overlap with narcolepsy type 2 and the limits of current testing. Stimulant and other wake-promoting medicines in the paper are described as clinician-managed. This is not a reason to increase one, and this note does not include a dose.

title: Performance evaluation of finger-worn devices for sleep stage classification and sleep apnea detection: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
relevance_note: A review of finger-worn sleep devices, including smart rings, compared with polysomnography for sleep stages and sleep apnea detection. It is background for an OSA or UARS question, a sleep study, and a ring-style tracker. It is not a product recommendation.
intervention_names: Upgrade Apple Watch and/or Oura Ring

title: Blue-light-filtering spectacle lenses in managing vision-related symptoms: an updated review.
relevance_note: A review of blue-light-filtering lenses for visual comfort and sleep, including reports about migraine frequency. The same review describes limited or uncertain benefit. It is background for amber blue-blocker glasses, not a reason to buy a specific pair.

title: Clinical, demographic, and lifestyle characteristics of patients with cervicogenic headache: comparison with an age- and sex-matched group of individuals with migraine.
journal: The Journal of Headache and Pain
relevance_note: A clinic comparison of cervicogenic headache and migraine, including neck pain and sleep posture. It is background for separating a cervical contribution from a migraine-spectrum pattern. It is not a diagnosis.

title: The Neurology of Menopause.
relevance_note: A review of menopause and several neurological conditions. It describes perimenopausal hormonal fluctuation as a time when migraine can worsen in susceptible people. It is background for that working idea, not a hormone plan.

title: Update to the management of recurrent urinary tract infections in women aged 16 years and older.
relevance_note: An overview of how recurrent urinary infections are assessed, including when a urine culture is used. It is background for that working idea. A culture is a question for a clinician. This note does not include an antibiotic plan.
intervention_names: Urine culture to rule out a cryptic UTI

title: Systemic Nickel Allergy Syndrome.
relevance_note: A review of systemic nickel allergy syndrome, including skin and gut symptoms after nickel exposure and the low-nickel diet discussed in that literature. It is background for the SNAS working idea, not a diagnosis and not a diet to start from this note.

title: Part II - imidazolines and rhinitis medicamentosa: how can we tackle the rebound dilemma?
relevance_note: A review of rebound congestion after prolonged use of topical imidazoline decongestants, including oxymetazoline. It is background for the nasal irrigation and Afrin question. It is not an instruction to start a decongestant.

title: An Exploration of the Interplay Between Caffeine and Antidepressants Through the Lens of Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics.
journal: European Journal of Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics
relevance_note: A review of how caffeine and antidepressants, including fluvoxamine, can affect each other. It is background for medication and drug-interaction questions, including any change to Luvox. Changing that medicine belongs with a clinician. This note does not include a dose.
intervention_names: Reduce Luvox from 150 mg to 100 mg

title: Melatonin and sleep: Exploring its role in regulating the circadian rhythm and sleep-wake cycle.
journal: Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care
relevance_note: A review of melatonin as a signal for circadian timing and sleep onset. It is background for a circadian reset and an earlier bedtime. It is not a dose and not an instruction to start melatonin.
intervention_names: Melatonin circadian reset for an earlier bedtime

title: The emerging role of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in idiopathic intracranial hypertension: Therapeutic potential and challenges.
relevance_note: An emerging review of GLP-1 receptor agonists in idiopathic intracranial hypertension. The evidence is early and uncertain. It is not a reason to start a GLP-1 medicine. Whether it is relevant is a question for a clinician.

title: From Sjögren syndrome to Sjögren disease: rethinking classification and diagnostic complexity.
journal: The Korean Journal of Internal Medicine
relevance_note: A review of how Sjögren disease is classified and why that label is easy to miss or over-call in routine care. It is background for the autoimmune working idea and for asking a clinician about repeat labs. It is not a diagnosis.
intervention_names: Retest vitamins, thyroid, and autoimmune panels, especially Sjögren's
